The v0.58.0 release cut, 2026-09-10. Ships one new reply block — `settled_question_prose` on `set_decision_status` and `governed_by` — and the cause-recording boundary that parked 228 pre-detector fixes.

Schema stamp unchanged (28 node types, 65 edge types), so no upgrade note is owed; step 3's conditionality was checked by diffing the stamp field by field against `git show v0.57.0:docs/design/reflow2.json` rather than assumed.
